fields.rt-blog-html:
While Sodexo, Compass, and Elior still largely dominate the institutional food service market, the sector remains highly fragmented. Hospitals, nursing homes, companies, embassies, schools, and the armed forces—a vast number of organizations rely on these groups, which are capable of providing meals for the members of a specific community at a reasonable price. 

History, core business, values, key figures - get to know France's largest contract catering companies!

‍

1. Sodexo, the world leader in foodservices

The leading player in the institutional food service sector is Sodexo. The company was founded in 1966 by Pierre Bellon in Marseille. Between 1971 and 1978, it took its first steps into international markets, expanding into Belgium, Italy, and Spain, followed by Africa and the Middle East. The company then went public in 1983. 

Sodexo promises its customers an authentic and gourmet dining experience, a wide variety of choices, access to the expertise of talented chefs, healthy food, and responsible sourcing. Through various services such as CROC’ (school meals) and Toqla (corporate catering), the company is committed to improving the daily lives of millions of people around the world—because, yes, a meal can truly make a difference in someone’s day, regardless of their age or circumstances!

The Sodexo Group in figures : 

  • 412,000 employees worldwide, including 35,000 in France,
  • 100 million consumers a day in 56 countries.

‍

2. Elior, creativity at the service of contract catering

Another major player in the sector was founded in 1991: the Elior Group. After acquiring the catering companies Les Repas Parisiens (LRP), Hôpital Service (in the healthcare sector), Vivaë, l'Alsacienne, and Ansamble, Elior gradually established itself as one of the leaders in the institutional catering market in France. In 2019, the group decided to discontinue its concession-based food service operations, which were grouped under the Areas brand, in order to refocus on its core business: institutional food service. 

This company has a clear ambition: to be the leading restaurant chain through a strategy based on five core principles:  

  • offer tasty, creative recipes to make mealtime a real pleasure,
  • guarantee food safety,
  • being a responsible employer,
  • respect the environment,
  • innovate.

This strategy is further reinforced by the company’s commitment to the following six areas: customized dining, nutrition for all ages, local products, initiatives to reduce food waste and plastic use, staff training and talent development, and the fight against inflation. This is how they manage to stand out from their competitors and offer their customers real added value. These commitments are particularly focused on the fight against food waste, for which there is a national anti-food-waste label.

Elior offers a food service solution tailored to all types of diners and all mealtimes: from newborns in daycare centers to high school students, as well as adults at their workplaces and patients and healthcare providers in healthcare facilities.

Elior in figures : 

  • an excellent nationwide network with more than 9,500 locations throughout France,
  • more than 850,000 meals served in schools (400,000), businesses (300,000), and healthcare facilities (150,000),
  • more than 20,000 employees (kitchen, service, management). 

3. Compass, tailor-made catering

The company's history dates back to 1960, when Eurest was founded. Compass Group acquired the company in 1977. It subsequently merged with SHRM, and went on to buy, acquire, sell, and establish several companies. Since its inception, Compass has been guided by a guiding principle: to offer high-quality, innovative service to everyone who enjoys its meals. 

Compass prides itself on a personalized approach tailored to the nature of each facility, as well as a creative culinary experience. Through its brands—Exalt for businesses, Medirest for healthcare and medical-social facilities, and Scolarest for schools and local governments—the group offers solutions that are closely aligned with each client’s specific needs. 

Compass Group France in figures : 

  • more than 13,000 employees,
  • nearly 155 million meals served every year,
  • 2,240 client establishments.

4. Restalliance, a catering solution for healthcare establishments

Restalliance was founded in 1993 by Christophe Dassonville. From the very beginning, the company based its growth strategy on three core principles: a people-first approach, independence, and high standards. 

This company specializes in institutional food service for healthcare facilities (hospitals, clinics, nursing homes, senior living communities, etc.) and is committed to improving the lives of vulnerable individuals. Recognizing the impact that good nutrition has on the daily lives of patients and residents, Restalliance places their comfort, enjoyment, and well-being at the heart of every meal by offering appetizing and generous dishes. To this end, the company pays particular attention to the quality, freshness, and seasonality of its ingredients. 

Restalliance in figures: 

  • 3,200 employees,
  • 30 years of experience

 5. Arpège, top-of-the-range contract catering

Arpège is a subsidiary of the Elior Group. It is considered the group's "urban style" brand. 

Arpège positions itself as a premium corporate catering service. The brand views the lunch break as a real opportunity to enhance employee well-being. 

At the brand’s 120 partner restaurants, you’ll find an experience that’s still relatively rare in institutional dining: food courts. Employees can dine at one of these six mini-restaurants: Le Passe (bistro), Sensé (100% vegetarian), Da Gino (Italian), Zesté (salad bar), Brut (meat, poultry, and fish), and Léché (desserts). All of these upscale dining options, however, share a few common traits. Among them: taste, a balance of flavors, discovery, and wonder.

Takeout, room service, event catering, flexible dining options, and all-day service—Arpège’s offerings are extremely diverse. 

Arpège in figures: 

  • 30 years of expertise,
  • 70,000 meals a day,
  • 1,700 employees.

‍

6. Ansamble, a company with a mission 

Now it’s time to get to know Ansamble, another key player in the institutional food service industry. The company was founded in 1978 in Vannes, in the Morbihan department. At the time, it was known as Breiz Restauration before becoming Ansamble in 2002. The following years were marked by expansion across the entire country. It later became part of the Elior Group. It is the first company in the institutional food service sector to display the Nutriscore and Carbon Score on its menus.

Ansamble is a mission-driven company. What does that mean in practice? It means that it is not driven solely by the pursuit of profit. Rather, it seeks to balance economic performance with contributing to the public good on social, societal, and environmental fronts. 

It is designed for early childhood education and care facilities as well as businesses and medical-social organizations. It makes it a point of honor to nourish its guests at every stage of their lives by offering them a diet based on four pillars: 

  • to promote the health of as many people as possible through a healthy and balanced diet,
  • contribute to the development of the regions where it operates by using local products sourced through short supply chains,
  • provide employees with pleasant working conditions and surroundings,
  • Protect the environment by carefully selecting products and reducing waste and plastic use. 

‍

7. API Restauration, a family business

API Restauration—perhaps you've heard of it? This family-owned business was founded in 1956. It started out as a deli and catering shop. Gradually, it shifted its focus to delivering meals to company cafeterias, a sector in which it quickly experienced strong growth. 

API Restauration’s cuisine is designed to be responsible, healthy, and delicious. The chefs put their talent and creativity to work for our guests while prioritizing high-quality ingredients and the use of local and seasonal produce. The recipes are systematically reviewed by a team of 80 dietitians and nutritionists whose job is to ensure that everyone’s nutritional needs are met. 

API Restauration in figures: 

  • 900,000 meals prepared each day,
  • 10,100 employees, including 9,000 in France,
  • more than 10% growth over 20 years.

‍

8. Convivio, 1st independent foodservice group in western France

The year 1982 marked the founding of Restéco in Rennes. The company subsequently took over Bretagne Restauration, Houlé Restauration, PoitouResco, and Sogerest. Convivio was officially established in 2010 and brought together all of the entities listed above. 

Convivio is the leading independent contract food service group in western France. Why is this important? This distinction gives them the freedom to act when it comes to the chefs’ menu choices, the selection of local products and suppliers, and the group’s development strategy.

Working with Convivio means choosing a company on a human scale that combines customized catering solutions with authentic, responsible cuisine tailored to the needs of its guests. Convivio is committed to providing high-quality culinary services to its target audiences: working professionals, children and teenagers in schools, and seniors or people with disabilities living in medical-social facilities. 

Convivio in figures : 

  • 2,600 employees,
  • 2,700 customers,
  • 300,000 guests served per day. 

‍

9. Newrest, a versatile player

The company was founded in 1996 under the name Catair. In 2001, it joined Compass’s airline catering division and became Newrest in 2005. This company is unique in that it operates across all sectors of the food service industry and related services: airline catering, concession-based food service, field camps and support services, rail catering, airport and highway food service concessions, and many others. 

Companies, embassies, clinics, hospitals, government agencies, and schools—many organizations choose to entrust the management of their cafeterias to the Newrest team. Choosing this company means opting for healthy, varied meals that guests can enjoy in a pleasant setting. It also means ensuring that everyone’s nutritional needs are met and that food safety is maintained through the highest standards. 

Newrest in figures : 

  • 36,622 employees,
  • present in 54 countries.

‍

10. Dupont Restauration, a company on a human scale

Dupont Restauration is a renowned company in the foodservice sector. With decades of experience, it has established itself as one of the industry's leaders in providing top-quality catering solutions. It caters to schools, businesses, healthcare institutions and local authorities.

Dupont Restauration's philosophy is based on fundamental values such as product quality, compliance with health standards, ingredient traceability and sustainable development. The company uses local suppliers and favors fresh, seasonal and organic produce to guarantee healthy, balanced cuisine.

This contract food service provider also places great emphasis on innovation and culinary creativity. Its team of talented and passionate chefs creates varied, flavorful menus tailored to different dietary preferences. The company prides itself on offering an exceptional dining experience to every guest.

In terms of services, Dupont Restauration offers a complete range from self-service catering to table service and fast food. It also runs campaigns to raise awareness of the importance of a balanced diet and the fight against food waste.

Dupont Restauration in figures:

  • 750,000 meals served per day,
  • more than 800 restaurants under management,
  • 3,000 employees.

‍

11. Sogères

To hear about Sogères for the first time, we have to go back to 1986, when the first corporate cafeteria opened. The company operates in three market segments: corporate and government, education, and health and social services. 

Part of its success stems from the selection of products, which are then elevated by the chefs. Sogères places taste, freshness, and seasonality; relationships with trusted partners; environmental stewardship; and local expertise at the heart of its food procurement strategy. Passion, culinary excellence, and generosity reign in the group’s kitchens. And all of this comes through on the guests’ plates!

Sogères in figures : 

  • 350,000 meals served per day,
  • 1,300 restaurants,
  • 5,000 employees. 

Would you like to deepen your knowledge of institutional food service? Companies like the Pomona Group, Mille et un repas, the Bertrand Group, Terres de cuisine, and Elite haven’t revealed all their secrets yet, so feel free to keep exploring! 

👉 To learn more: Who are the competitors in the institutional food service industry? 

-
